The NHL stats API

Source: R/stats.R
nhl_stats.Rd

The API behind NHL.com/stats: any report it has ("skater/summary", "skater/realtime", "skater/timeonice", "skater/bios", "goalie/summary", "team/summary" and many more; see nhl_stats_reports()), by season or game by game, filtered and sorted.

Usage

nhl_stats(
  report = "skater/summary",
  season = NULL,
  game_type = "regular",
  filter = NULL,
  sort = NULL,
  limit = -1,
  aggregate = FALSE,
  by_game = FALSE
)

nhl_stats_reports()

Arguments

report

The report, e.g. "skater/summary".

season

Season (see nhl_season()); NULL for the current one, or a vector of two for a range.

game_type

"regular", "playoffs" or "preseason".

filter

Extra Cayenne expressions, a character vector.

sort

Column to sort by, descending; prefix with "+" for ascending.

limit

Rows to return; -1 for all.

aggregate

TRUE sums a range of seasons into one row per player.

by_game

TRUE for one row per player per game.

Value

A tibble.

For nhl_stats_reports(), a tibble of the reports the API offers.

Details

Filters are the API's own Cayenne expressions, joined with and: filter = "teamAbbrevs='EDM'", filter = "gamesPlayed>=20".

Every season back to 1917-18 is there, but not every column: shots and plus/minus start in 1959-60, ice time in 1997-98, hits in 2005-06. nhl_stat_eras() has each column's first season, and sorting by one for seasons before it says so.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
nhl_stats("skater/summary", "2025-26", sort = "points", limit = 10)
nhl_stats("goalie/summary", filter = "gamesPlayed>=20", sort = "+goalsAgainstAverage")
nhl_stats("skater/realtime", c(2015, 2025), aggregate = TRUE, sort = "hits", limit = 20)
nhl_stats("skater/summary", "1981-82", sort = "points", limit = 5)
}
